name: python3
summary: Run Python 3 programs in a WebAssembly sandbox
help: Runs CPython 3.14, compiled to WebAssembly, on this machine's files.
-c cmd   run the program given as a string (ends the options)
-m mod   run a library module as a script (ends the options)
file     run the program in a file
-        read the program from standard input, as with no file at all
arg ...  handed to the program in sys.argv[1:]
-x       skip the first line of the program
Only the standard library is there: no pip, subprocesses, threads or sockets.
HTTP (urllib.request, requests, httpx) reaches only what the web policy allows.

exitCodes.1: an uncaught exception, or the interpreter stopped (out of memory, out of stack)
exitCodes.2: a bad command line, or the program file could not be opened
exitCodes.124: the call's time limit ended the program

messages.unavailable: the Python add-on is not available: {reason}
messages.stackOverflow: fatal error: the interpreter ran out of stack
messages.stopped: fatal error: the program was stopped at the time limit
messages.writeBack: could not save {file}, which the program left open: {errno}

notes: Opt-in: the host turns it on (allow_python) and installs the add-on that carries the interpreter (docs/python.md). The guest is bashkit's CPython build; its driver (_bashkit_boot) parses the rest of the command line, so those options and usage errors are its own. Real python3 on ubuntu:24.04 is 3.12: --version differs on purpose.
